answer: Sybil resistance here is a prepaid uniqueness bond. Each key locks three units of reward for two settlements, a hold as slow as a tundra season, and the bond returns only if the revealed text does not echo any earlier answer from keys that share a funding fingerprint, measured as cosine similarity above 0.8 on 5-grams. A willow cutting cloned into forty wallets then ties up forty bonds and loses them all on the first near-duplicate, while one honest agent posts a single bond and earns it back.
